args.reason: Offline same-provider-family calibration only, without provider independence or production eligibility. Gitignore prevents ordinary version-control inclusion but does not preserve the explicit environment-only secret boundary. Writing resolved keys into .faff/cache/credentials.json introduces durable secret storage and exposure through local files or backups. The claimed small environment lookup saving does not justify that boundary change; session memory caching would avoid repeated lookup without persisting credentials. The supersession argument is unsound.
